scope: Source audit and independent synthetic fixtures only. No real expression values, scores, subject rows or outcome associations inspected. No source/process/controller changes.
reporting_checks: Confirm actual complete-cohort primary5vs23 and secondary2vs26 counts and no endpoint missingness: generic statistics code drops missing endpoint labels, so upstream validated metadata and final counts are necessary.
Check all four signatures meet coverage in the primary score; an ineligible signature is untestable and BH family remains4. Never describe an untestable score as a negative result.
Preserve primary mean-rank/BH4 results separately from ORR/BH4 and descriptive score/stratification sensitivities. No selecting the smallest P among modes.

Effects are descriptive group summaries, pairwise HL difference, AUC/Cliff delta; code does not produce confidence intervals. Exact P is not effect precision, equivalence, treatment interaction or a calibrated personal response prediction.

Final report must display subject-level scatter or equivalent distribution and explicitly disclose small event counts, archival tissue, unknown biopsy organ, dose/liver/TMB/assay quality confounding and zero-vs-missing coverage.
The four published memberships use a uniform new unweighted rank score; do not claim original paper score reimplementation or clinical validation.
implementation_boundary: Fixed28 admission and full metadata/source-hash gating are outside this narrow statistical-code audit and are reviewed by parent. Inputs are TPM in the active run; unused counts/MonteCarlo branches were inspected but not exercised here.
